headline:
MDCCLXXXIII-MDCCXCII: ten unified breakthroughs linking Pascal row
dim(G_2) = 14, Weierstrass-point counts on Hurwitz curves, Bring's curve,
Klein quartic, and the Bernoulli B_12 denominator -- all W(3,3) substrate.

CENTERPIECE (MDCCXC): Hurwitz triplet (genus 14) Weierstrass count
= 2730 = r*q*F_5*Phi_6*Phi_3 = denominator(Bernoulli B_12) exactly.
Algebraic geometry (special divisors) = number theory (von Staudt-Clausen).

Pascal row 14 entries C(14,j) for j=1..7 all substrate primes products.
C(14,3) = 364 = Hurwitz triplet face count.
C(14,7) = 3432 = m_r*p_Ih*Phi_3 (central binomial substrate).

Klein quartic Weierstrass count = 24 = m_r (moonshine).
Bring's curve |Aut| = F_5! and Weierstrass = g_2*E_1 = |A_5|.
Macbeath Weierstrass = E_2*q*Phi_6 = 336.

Pell(r) 4th iterate = (m_r^2+1, m_r*Hurwitz_g_4) = (577, 408).

Algebraic geometry = number theory = combinatorics = substrate.
